treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Poland and the Government of the Syrian Arab Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2001)
source_title: Dz.U. 2004 nr 193 poz. 1972 — PL-SY Convention, Polish/English text (podatki.gov.pl scan; read visually)

rates.quote: 2. Dividends mentioned in paragraph 1 may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 18 percent of the gross amount of the royalties referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article.

ppt.basis: none (no PPT in treaty; SY not an MLI signatory)

notes: Interest: Art. 11(3) residence-only where the recipient is a Contracting State, local authority or statutory body incl. central bank, or interest paid by such bodies, or on debt-claims/loans guaranteed, insured or supported by a Contracting State (not modelled). Royalty definition includes industrial/scientific equipment. Art. 27: EIF on the date of the later notification (23.12.2003); WHT applies to amounts paid/credited on/after 1 January of the year following EIF (2004-01-01). Quotes from the authentic English column (prevails), transcribed visually from the scanned Dziennik Ustaw. Not MLI-covered.
